title: Rav Yehudah bar Idi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Rosh Hashanah 31a, saying in the name of Rabbi Yohanan: “The Shekhinah traveled ten journeys.” Dikdukei Soferim cites the reading “Rabbi Yehudah bar Idi said in the name of Rabbi Oshaya”; Yuchasin HaShalem has the same reading.
A homily of his appears in Tanchuma, Bereshit 21: the decree against the generation of the Flood was not sealed until they wrote gamkisum (marriage documents) for males and for animals.

notes.text: Hyman reports an Oshaya transmission in place of Yohanan. “Gamkisum” preserves his printed term and his own gloss “marriage document.”

The consulted Rosh Hashanah 31a transmits the saying through Rabbi Yohanan. The Oshaya reading in Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin HaShalem is Hyman’s report; those exact editions were not directly inspected.
